_comment: Results pack config. Every path is relative to repo_root (itself relative to this file) unless --repo-root is given on the command line. To pick up new data after a merge, rerun build.py; to point at another checkout: python build.py --repo-root /path/to/ge2340-team
upload_eval_note: The upload-app (Tian's walksense.py) numbers are read from phase2/new/upload/out/eval.json as it was when this pack was built (after PROCESS-LOG 90: floor rule d for barometer phones, the a56 night out of the a56 model); rebuild the pack whenever the app is retrained. The upload app has its own session list (upload/walksense.py SESSIONS, which includes the 25-Nov night run) and does not read day3/config.json, so the day-3 a56 night exclusion is NOT applied to the upload-app numbers.
